description:
Wait for a collect_secret request that came back still "awaiting" — which happens when
offprompt runs in a cloud sandbox, or had no browser to open and handed you the page URL to pass on. Long-polls for up to 60 seconds and returns
"written", "awaiting" or "expired". Call it again while the status is "awaiting", with no other work in between. When
you were given a link to pass on, an "awaiting" result carries it again: keep it in whatever you write to the user, or
ask them, until the values are written.
name: await_secret

emoji.description: A fingerprint of the values as the file holds them. The user's page shows the four it took from what they typed. Write them to the user as soon as the call returns, before your next tool call.

file_keys.description: Every key the file holds after the write, names only, so the file never needs opening.

tell_user.description: The line to write to the user as soon as the call returns, before your next tool call: "Fingerprint" and the four emoji their page shows.

url.description: The page the user has to open, while the request is awaiting and the link is yours to pass on.

written_anyway.description: Keys the user wrote although their values did not pass offprompt's checks: the provider may have changed the format, or the value may be wrong.

title: Wait for a secret to be written
